description: Build content details/metadata screens in SwiftUI. Display movie/show details with ScrollView layout, cast/crew horizontal lists, ratings display, trailer playback integration, Trakt comments section, similar content recommendations. Implement season/episode picker for TV shows. Add watchlist toggle, rating buttons, share sheet. Fetch metadata from Rust SDK (TMDB + Trakt). Adaptive layouts for iOS/iPad/tvOS.
title: Phase 3.5: iOS/tvOS Content Details/Metadata Screens
